balls.text: they steal a bye, tries to smack a slower one over midwicket, misses
Chawla finds the boundary, straying on the pads and he picks that one well, it's a full toss, swinging it over square leg for a boundary
short on the off, Praveen Kumar makes room and tries to slap that over extra cover, doesn't get hold of it, offers a simple catch to Yusuf at extra cover
Chawla mistimes a pull, gets a single past midwicket
full on middle, drives it back down the pitch to the bowler, Kallis gets his foot to it, just the single
Gony goes but he's played a fine hand, short and he went for the pull, got an inside edge onto the stumps
keeps strike, full toss and that's struck to long-on for a single, 23 off the over, Narine's been brought down to earth quickly
this is a gem of a knock, Punjab are regaining lost ground, quicker but short and that's clobbered miles over the deep midwicket fence
Gony is playing his first game this season and is already making a name for himself, short from Narine and that's pulled away into the deep and into the gap, four more
Well, Gony is doing his best to compensate for that loss in momentum that the hat-trick brought up, on middle and leg and was in the slot for the big man, got under it ti launch it miles over long-on
tapped that one in front of point for a single
called a wide, landed well outside off and turned away, Chawla missed
Chawla gets a boundary to his name, tossed up outside off, Chawla picks it up well, swinging it clean over midwicket for a one bounce four

slower one and it should go down as a drop, Gambhir has a sly smile on his face, went through with the shot, didn't pick the change in pace, it landed right in front of long-on and midwicket, the fielders failed to make up their minds about who was going for it, it landed right between the two
slower one bowled short again, he tries to go over point this time, had to reach for it, missed
slower one this time, a slower bounce and Gony had readied himself for a big one over midwicket, missed
shot, clubbed down the ground, slightly short on the off and he swats it past the bowler, long-on and long-off had no chance
swing and a miss, the shot was on it seemed, tried to clear midwicket again did Gony but didn't connect, didn't bounce as much as he would have liked
guides that one to point, Gambhir throws at the non-striker's end, misses, and they get an overthrow
Crucial runs for Punjab from Gony, banged in short on the off and he absolutely hammered that one over midwicket
a bit of width on that one, Chawla just drives that back towards the bowler
flicked away through midwicket into the deep for a single
lovely delivery from Narine again, that turned away and Gony tried to open the face on that one
shortish outside off, chops it towards short third man for a single
pushes that back towards the bowler

the spinners are turning it on for KKR, Miller just missed that, went on straight, on middle and leg and he rocked back to whip it through midwicket, just seemed late on that one, missed and the leg stump was knocked back
round the wicket, pushes that full on the off, defended for a single
Gony dispatches that long hop, short, turns in and he is prepared for it, rocks back to pull it over midwicket
shortish on the off, punched back towards the bowler
another leading edge, Gony closes the face on Senanayake this time and gets away, went past slip to the third-man boundary, long chase for Kallis from slip
drives that one towards long-on for a single

Narine has grabbed a hat-trick, Gurkeerat is clueless about the carrom ball, fired that in quick, landed on middle and turned away as he again, tried to turn the face to play it into the leg side. He missed and the off stump was pegged back, KKR on top now
gone first ball, Mahmood heads back, appeared to go straight on, tried to turn the face first ball, got a leading edge and offered the simplest of catches back to Narine

Hussey has to go, was much slower through the air but good bounce once it landed, spat in as Hussey went for the cut, he got a thick edge and it struck Bisla on the chest, popped out, only for the keeper to take it well on the second attempt
beaten by the carrom well, went the other way, tried to open the face on that one and missed
worked away off the back foot for a single past square leg

good effort from Balaji running to his left from deep backward square leg, Miller went for the sweep, got a top edge over short fine and it landed just in front of Balaji who dived, but in vain, still managed to save a couple of runs
third man is up, short and that was cut towards him for just the single
pitched on a length on middle, drives it down to long-on for a single
slower one on middle, Hussey works that away through midwicket, does so fairly gently and rushes back for the second
full on the off, drives it down towards long-off for a single
picks the length early, ends up being a long hop and Miller thrashes that hard over midwicket for a one bounce four
floating that one on the pads, tries to flick it square, clips the pads and rolls fine for a single
gets forward, gets an inside edge as he tries to stab it into the leg side, these two have run brilliantly, deep midwicket has a fair distance to run in to collect that and they've stolen two more
angling in towards middle, drives it back towards the bowler
quicker through the air, Hussey got on the back foot and played it past the bowler for a single
slightly short on the off, pulled away past midwicket into the deep, two more
slightly short on middle, punches it towards long-on from the crease for a single
on the pads, two more for these two, Gambhir is upset, flicked past square leg and he didn't think there was a second in that one
Miller knocks that one away for a single to keep strike
full toss on middle, driven through midwicket for a single into the deep
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away well but straight to point
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, square-driven past point into the deep for a single
shortish on the off, crunched from the crease towards deep extra cover for a single
struck him outside leg stump as he tried to work that past midwicket, appeared to get an inside edge
flicks that one towards fine leg for another single
short of a good length on the off, taps it away in front of point for a single
slower one on the off, pushed it towards extra cover
shortish outside off, Miller cuts that one towards third man for a single to get off the mark
pushed it off the front foot towards the bowler

He's walking off is the batsman, Mandeep came down the track to that short ball from Kallis, tried to smash that over midwicket, got a faint nick to the keeper, Kallis and Bisla went up immediately, the umpire didn't seem convinced but Mandeep walked back and the umpire then raised his finger
slower one on middle, pushed through midwicket for a single
slower ball, a bit of width, cracked towards deep cover for just the single
slower one bowled short on middle, worked away through square leg for a single
slower one bowled short on middle, worked away through square leg, the fielder takes a while to get to it, they steal a couple
punches that one towards long-off for a single
fullish on leg stump, tries to clip it fine, gets an inside edge onto the pads
slower one bowled short outside off, cuts that past point for a single
Hussey presses that one away to get off the mark

Balaji has struck, back of a length again and Manan tries to do what Mandeep did earlier in the over, came down the track to pull it over midwicket, good bounce for Balaji, got the top edge and Balaji took a simple catch
angling in towards middle, pushed in the direction of mid-on for a single
third man is up, Narine's not the greatest fielder of all time, he fumbles as he tries to cit that past him, a couple more for Punjab
dropped that one short, back of a length it sits up nicely for Mandeep who pulls it away hard over midwicket
slower one on middle, pushed through past midwicket into the deep for a well-run couple
comes down the pitch and drives that uppishly past the bowler to long-off for a single
low full toss, rare mistake from Bhatia, makes a bit of room does Mandeep and drills it down the ground, straight past the bowler
the leg cutter, comes down the track and plays it towards deep midwicket for a single
slower one bowled on middle and leg, tickled into the leg side for a single
knocked away for a single
back of a length on middle, gets on the back foot and plays it in front of midwicket for a single
slower one bowled full on the off, strikes that one hard towards long-on for a single
pushed away into the off side from the crease
the camera lost it, back of a length and Vohra went after it, rocked back and just struck it on the rise over extra cover, one bounce four
bowling slow seems the way to go here, comes down the track and punches it through cover into the deep
slower one on the off, pushes it through cover for a single

missed run-out, poor call for a single there, pushed in front of extra cover and Vohra ran for it, it was his call, he was running to the danger end, Gambhir picked it up at extra cover and should have under-armed that onto the stumps at the non-striker's end but missed, Vohra was gone had that struck
shortish on middle, punched down to long-on for a single
slightly short on middle, tried to close the face on that one, played it back down the pitch
flighted on middle, pushed it towards extra cover, called for the single, was sent back
quicker through the air on middle, tapped away into the off side
sweetly struck, floating it full outside off and Mandeep slog-swept that hard over midwicket for a one bounce four
went straight on, short on the off, punched back towards the bowler
beaten by the carrom ball again, shorter and turned away to go past the outside edge as he poked at it
flighted and he accepts the invitation, tossed up on the off and he smashes that over the bowler's head, there is a long-on in place but he is a little wide
and again, gets on the back foot and punches it towards the bowler
this was definitely the carrom ball, turned away from a good length outside off as he looked to drive, went past the outside edge
may have been the carrom ball, on the off and appeared to go the other way, pushed into the off side
slightly short on the off, off the mark, taps that in front of extra cover and races off for a single

gone! Gilly didn't pick the carrom ball, yes Senanayake has one too, landed short outside off and came back in to rap Gilly on the pads as he got on the back foot to whip it in the direction of midwicket, the umpire had no hesitation, would have hit off and middle. Not sure if there was an inside edge there, the umpire certainly didn't think so
flighted on the off, comes down the track and chips that one towards long-on for a single
shortish outside off, held its line, went straight on, tried to cut, missed
slightly short on middle, whipped through to deep midwicket for a single
floating it on middle, gets forward and works it into the leg side for a single
goodish length, keeps strike by knocking that into the off side in front of point for a quick single
in front of square leg this time, nice wristwork from Mandeep, angling in towards middle and he flicks it away for four more
Mandeep picks the length early, that was bowled short on middle and he whipped it hard past short fine leg for four
missed out there, was a meaty full toss on the off, mistimes it towards mid-off and races through for a single
lovely timing, slightly short, he rocks back to just punch it through extra cover and past the diving mid-off, just a punch
the slower offcutter and Gilly was looking to deposit that over mid-off, missed as it went past the swing of the bat
straighter from Kallis, on middle and that;s been clipped down to short fine leg, no run on offer there
slower one bowled on a good length on middle, played it to mid-on for a quick single
comes forward and works it away into the leg side, a fumble at square leg and he's stolen a single
flat-batted from Mandeep, fetched it from outside off, short and he slaps it hard over mid-on
shortish on middle, tries to pull that over square leg, ends up hitting the bottom of the bat
bowls that one in the channel outside off and he leaves that one be
slightly short on the off, pushes it slightly uppishly towards point
slashed away, straight to point though, some width on that one and Gilchrist goes hard at it, struck straight to the fielder
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, pushes that one to mid-off
gets front and across and pushes it back towards the bowler
on a good length on leg stump, moves across slightly and pushes that towards mid-on
almost a wide again, this time on the off, but the umpire gives the bowler the benefit of the dount there, marginal call, Gilly lets it go
that one's down the leg side, KKR start with a wide, Punjab are off the mark
full and wide this time, almost yorker length and Narine misses as he goes after that one, dot ball and Kings XI have won
Called a wide, five needed to win and four to tie, dropped it really short outside off, was wide and also too high

nice change of pace there, Senanayake misses, went for the pull, didn't pick the slower ball, missed, just the bye, PK collects near the bowler's end and throws it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end, Senanayake is just short as the bail pops out, run out
slow full toss and Narine slices it towards deep cover for a single, just the single
Senanayake makes room to that fullish delivery and drives it to extra cover for a single
low full toss and Yusuf has holed out! Picked it up well reaching forward but found David Miller at deep midwicket, who moved to his left and took an excellent catch under pressure
appeal for lbw, swung in, struck on the back pad, almost yorker length and Yusuf missed it, may have missed leg, Taufel shook his head, two more
thank god for Adam Gilchrist, Kings XI will say, dived full length to his left to stop that, horrible wide down the leg side by Praveen
bowled'im, another twist, Awana's celebrating, but after conceding 19. Slower one bowled short outside off, Bhatia tried to drag it through square leg again, gets an inside edge onto the stumps
Bhatia you beauty! He's taken over from Yusuf, shortish on leg stump, made a bit of room and swung it away over deep square leg for six more
slaps that towards long-on, not timed too well but he manages to come back for the second, long-on is deep and Yusuf took him on
Bhatia connects and connects superbly, length ball on middle and he got under it to launch it over long-on for six, much needed for KKR
misses out this time, went for a pull again, gets an inside edge for a single
four, no stopping that, short and he went for a mighty pull, got a top edge over the keeper for four
full toss on middle, cracks that towards long-on for a single to keep strike
slower one bowled short outside off, slapped it towards deep midwicket for one more
in the slot on the off stump, drives it down the ground to long-on for a single
sliding it straight, gets across to flick it square into the deep for a single

KKR are sliding here, Debabrata might be gone, angling in towards middle, gets across to play it into the leg side, is struck on the pads, Taufel gave it out immediately after the Kings XI players went up, struck him in line with middle and leg, that was out
slower one bowled short again, pulls that towards deep square leg for a single
short on middle, pulled towards deep midwicket for a single
slower one and Yusuf flat-bats that hard over mid-off, that man is inside the circle and he crashed that for a one bounce four
back of a length and Yusuf tries to pull that over square leg, good sharp short ball and he misses
turns that towards midwicket, bowled at 133.8kmph, for a single, Hussey picks up and throws at the non-striker's end, misses, would have been close
short of a good length on middle, pushes that back to the bowler

bowled'in, Awana has struck, Tiwary was watching Yusuf go quiet at one end, the first ball he faces after that he tries to dispatch over midwicket, is a slower one bowled short, misses and it clips the bails
slower one bowled just over leg stump, Yusuf let that go but it wasn't a wide, landed on middle and leg, that
missed again, what an over, short and wide and Yusuf goes for the cut, doesn't make contact
beaten, short of a good length, moves away and just goes past the outside edge
down the leg side, tries to turn it down fine, called a wide there
shortish outside off, goes for the pull and misses, didn't bounce as much as he wanted
shortish on the off, plays that into the ground and towards point
back of a length on the off, gets on the back foot and turns it into the leg side, no run on offer there
gone this time, tried to turn this one away as well, got a leading edge this time however, Hussey at extra cover made no mistake
doesn't take the single, shortish on the off, punches it towards mid-off
how does he do that? Powerful wrists from Morgan, fullish, but outside off, he's just flicked it superbly over square leg, one bounce four, just a turn of the wrists, no flourish
Morgan comes down the track and just chips that over midwicket for a couple of runs
slower one bowled short on the off, plays it down in front of extra cover for another quick single
shortish on middle, knocks that down in front of point for a quick single
starts off with a wide down the leg side
dropped short, moved across and tried to pull it square, missed, Gilchrist and Gony appealed but Taufel wasn't interested
called wide, slower one bowled short down the leg side
Tiwary may have just put a bit of pressure on himself, came down the track to whack that over extra cover, missed
angling in towards middle, defends that one towards extra cover from the crease
back of a length on middle, gets on the back foot, keeps a little low, pushed towards extra cover
may have just nipped away, short of a good length and Tiwary fished for that one, missed
Gony sends back Gambhir, huge wicket for Punjab but has it come a little too late? On a length and Gambhir tried to drive it hard through extra cover, got a thick edge through to Gilchrist
short, wants to punch it through cover, the diving extra cover gets his hands to it, just the single
the googly, chops it just past the keeper for a single
gets on the back foot this time, turns past square leg for a single
Gambhir loves that shot and few play it better than he does, comes down the track to that flight delivery and drives that past extra cover, inside out, for four
gets forward and pushes that towards long-on, just past the bowler
turns that one through square leg for a single
bowled on a length, drives it down towards long-off for a single
beaten as he tries to open the face at the last moment to play it just past the keeper, misses
back of a length, plays that down to third man for one more
short and he mistimes a pull, plays that behind square for a single
Gambhir brings up his half-century, turns that away through square leg for two more runs, been very consistent this IPL
drops that short on leg stump, struck high on the pads as he tried to turn the face
gets on the back foot and punches it through to extra cover for a couple of runs
waits for that one to turn in and chops it past point for a single
swept straight to deep square leg this time
shot, picked the gap comfortably, a googly gone bad for Chawla, turns out to be a long hop, pulled away between deep square leg and deep midwicket
floaitng it full on middle, drives it through square leg for a single
shortish on the off, pulled away towards deep midwicket for a single
slower one bowled short, Morgan mistimes a pull towards deep square leg for a single
drops it short on leg, worked away off his hips towards fine leg for a single
shortish on the off, punched wide of mid-off for a single
valiant effort at third man, bowled one outside off, cuts away but Morgan plays that smartly, slashing that hard, getting a thick edge past the diving Mandeep in the deep
goes hard at that one, in the channel outside off and he was looking to square-drive that one, missed
back of a length outside off, runs that down to third man for a single
the googly again, Morgan gets an inside edge while trying to play the cut, into the ground and over the keeper
tickles that one through square leg for one more
the googly from Chawla, gets on the back foot and works it square for a single
four, Morgan plays the reverse-sweep, short on the off and he places that between a diving Praveen at short third and point
quicker through the air, short on the off and that's been pulled towards deep midwicket for a single
pitched up outside off and Gambhir goes over extra cover for a couple of runs
slightly short, flicks it wristily from the off past square leg for a single
banged in short and Gambhir tries to pull that past square leg, appeared to take his eyes off that one there, missed
short and Gambhir chops that hard past point, third man runs to his left and keeps them down to a couple
short and wide and Gambhir goes for the cut, misses
Morgan steps out to that one and drives that down the ground towards long-off for a single
back of a length and Morgan punches it well standing tall past extra cover for a couple of runs
shortish on the off, Morgan stabs that towards extra cover to steal a single
slightly short on the off, punched to long-on for a single
easily done, straying on the leg side this time and he just helps it with a nudge behind short fine leg, no chance for Awana, three in a row

four more, fullish outside off and Gambhir just sliced that with the turn through that narrow gap between point and short third, Praveen gave chase but was unable to drag it back in, the 50-stand is up
finds the gap, tossed up and he took it on the half-volley to loft that over extra cover,Miller at long-off dived to his right to stop that but couldn't get his body behind it
round the wicket, Gambhir is struck on the pads as he tries to work that square
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and times that very well, just punching it past mid-on for four, raced away
opened the face nicely there while trying to play it past backward point, found the fielder however
tried to drive that on up past extra cover, got an inside edge, Morgan wanted the single and ran through, Gambhir reacted late but no damage done
too short and not the best delivery with the fine leg up, Gambhir swivels and pulls it away behind square leg for four
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and chips it towards mid-on, not very well controlled there, hit him high on the bat
short of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single
slowish outside off, comes down the track and pushes that one past midwicket, the fielder in the deep takes a while to get to it and they come back for the second
knocks it away into the leg side off the front foot
slower one on middle, too straight from Praveen, Morgan has no trouble clipping that away wide of short fine leg
slower one on middle, gets across and turns it towards short fine leg for a single
pitched outside leg and kept extremely low, tried to flick it fine, clipped the pads on the way to the fine-leg boundary
short and wide from Praveen and Gambhir cashes in, making a bit of room and flaying it through point
tight over from Mahmood, on leg and middle, gets on the back foot and defends it into the leg side
slightly short on the off, chops that one down towards point
back of a length on middle, punched back towards the bowler
shortish on the pads and Morgan flicks that away past short fine, two more as deep square leg runs across to cut it off
back of a length on the off, rocks back and pushes it towards mid-off
banged in short and Gambhir pulls it towards deep square leg for a single
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, defended into the off side
got front and across there did Morgan and drove it towards mid-on, can't get it past him
slightly short outside off, runs that down to third man for a single
slower one and he picks that early, bowled in the slot as well, made a bit of room and absolutely drilled that past the bowler
gift ball on the pads and Gambhir has tickled that smartly past short fine leg for a boundary, easy pickings
chopped behind square on the off side for a single
lovely shot, a bit of width for Gambhir and he cracked that superbly between the two points, excellent timing
slightly short outside off, cracks that into the ground towards point
pitched outside leg, tries to work it into the leg side, struck on the pads, Mahmood appealed for an lbw there but those can't be given
on a good length on the off, pushes that towards point from the crease

early success for Mahmood as well, Mandeep holds on to a sharp chance at extra cover, Kallis made room there, loves to hit through extra cover, strikes it well but can't get it past Mandeep Singh who holds on to a toughie
slightly short on the off, pushes that wide of mid-off from the crease
comes down the track and tries to drive that through the covers, misses
gets front and across, that was bowled on middle and leg and he flicked it elegantly in the direction of fine leg for a single, just the single as it landed just in front of the fielder
n a good length, gets forward and pushes it back towards the bowler
bowled that full on middle, drives it down the pitch and towards the bowler
this one swung in, short of a good length, rocks on the back foot and punches it down the pitch

gone first ball! Praveen has struck, pitched on a good length, Bisla rocked forward to drive, got a thick edge, Mahmood at first slip dropped it but Adam Gilchrist was alert and took it as it popped out of Mahmood's hands
